assets.title: Opposed Attached-Lid Tote
assets.description: One original static opposed attached-lid logistics tote form. A single continuous tapered thick shell has a complete bottom, real deep empty cavity, full rim and two genuine short-end handholes. Two complete thick half lids are fixed outward and upward at 62 degrees above the horizontal; their facing edges have alternating full-thickness comb teeth and actual open notches. Four three-knuckle assemblies have complete thick through-bored ears, continuous solid headed pins, finite lower pin-bearing faces and full nonbearing bore clearances. Eight broad body-ear pedestals and four independent fixed-angle wedge stops have finite full support patches from the rim to the ears and lids. Four full flat feet support the shell. Newly authored shell, opposed lids and support geometry; no reused produce-crate body, copied bait-box lid, deleted battery divider or recolored suitcase. One form only: the plural turnover-box family remains partial and the existing open produce crate remains reusable. Metres, native Z up, front -Y, horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Constant opaque PBR only; no TEX_* nodes, linked Principled inputs, image/procedural textures, text, brand, animation or environment. Fixed visual geometry only: no opening/closing path, closing interlock, locking, stacking/nesting, load, transport suitability, food/hygiene, water/dust/air sealing, manufacturing/material, safety certification or old rack/pallet compatibility claim.
